//1: THE source for every shell surface (quickshell/: bar, launcher, OSD, power
//2: menu). The roles were transcribed from the @define-color block of the old
//3: waybar/style.css and from wofi/style.css — not invented; those stylesheets
//4: are gone and live only in git history. `tokens` keeps the Cybrcolors names
//5: so the lineage survives; `roles` is what QML actually reads. theme.lua
//6: still owns WINDOW chrome (gaps, border, blur, shadow); CI cross-checks it.
name: cyberpunk
//tokens: Cybrcolors name -> role, so a palette bump stays traceable.
//effects: Neon: text glows (the one halo-safe glow primitive), no scanlines.
//bar: Bar identity. Rounded neon glass: generous radius, a lit pink edge, and a soft pink bloom around each island — the window shadow in theme.lua at bar scale. accentLine (the old inset top hairline) is off: at 1.5x it read as a pink bar sitting on the islands.
//launcher: Launcher identity (was wofi/style.css): violet 2px frame, 12px window, 8px input + rows.
//osd: OSD identity (was swayosd/style.css): a neon pill — pink 2px frame, cyan track.
//session: Power-menu identity (was wlogout/style.css): 16px tiles, 1px pink edge at 35%.
//wallpaper: Shared by hyprlock.conf (brightness) and sddm/Main.qml (1 - brightness scrim).
